At the start of every month, many people working in South Africa send a little home: airtime, data, a way to stay in touch.

At Fluxr we've made that as simple as a USSD code. No smartphone, app or data bundle is needed. Buy a 1Voucher, OTT, Blu or FNB Voucher at a local store, dial *130*31026*VoucherPIN#, and airtime or data reaches family in Mozambique in seconds.

Why USSD? The people who most need cross-border top-ups are often the ones with the least data. Working on any phone, with cash vouchers people already buy, removes the friction.

This October we're putting Mozambique 🇲🇿 first, with top-ups for Vodacom, Movitel and Tmcel numbers.

Interested in partnering with us, or in becoming a Fluxr Agent? Message us on WhatsApp at +27 60 636 0061 or visit www.fluxr.co.za.
